1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor that is __perceptually distinct from the first alarm__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer, and wherein __acknowledgment of the second alarm prevents transmission of the output to initiate the escalated alarm__.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm __and the second alarm comprises an audible alarm__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm __that is louder and of different frequency than the first alarm__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm, __and wherein the escalated alarm has a different frequency pattern than the first alarm__.

6. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system, __and wherein the central patient management system maintains a log of alarm events including timestamp, alarm type, and acknowledgment status__.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __a level of escalation, and acknowledgment status__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data __in a prioritized manner based on escalation level__.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system, __and wherein the system is configured to communicate bidirectionally with remote stations__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm, __and wherein the escalation level is automatically incremented based on lack of acknowledgment within predetermined time intervals__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, __and wherein acknowledgment by a remote station prevents escalation of the alarm at the physiological monitor__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices, __and wherein the wireless devices receive escalation notifications when acknowledgment is not received within a predetermined timeframe__.
